shots.focal_element: Floating 'Present' dropdown menu (Board / All frames / Smart Meeting) under a toolbar strip with a blue Share button
on_screen_text: Present every frame as a slide
Run a collaborative session with apps and activities
Look at those awsome new stickers!
shots.typography: Product UI sans (Miro-like, low-confidence guess: Open Sans/Roobert) in sentence case; menu titles regular weight dark grey, descriptions smaller lighter grey; oversized Share button label in medium-weight white on blue; sticky-note text in a hand-written-feel sans.
shots.what_happens: Opens mid-motion on an isolated, enlarged Present menu on a white canvas; within about half a second the camera pulls back so the menu shrinks toward centre while other floating UI fragments (a sticker sticky note, a large Share button, a coral card edge) drift in from the edges, establishing a collage.
shots.build_rebuild: Place a recreated Present-menu component at 1.0 scale on a white canvas and tween the whole canvas group from scale 1.6 to 1.0 over ~0.6 s with a strong ease-out, while 3-4 satellite UI cards (sticky note, Share button, coral card) slide in from the frame edges with slight motion blur.

shots.focal_element: Centered bold title 'Interactive presentations' surrounded by floating product elements (sticky notes with vote badges, reaction bar, emoji, Present menu, 3D smartwatch render)
shots.typography: Title in a heavy geometric sans (low-confidence guess: Roobert/Gilroy Bold), sentence case, two stacked lines, tight leading, normal tracking, near-black; sticky-note labels in a regular sans, centered; reaction-bar labels small medium-weight UI sans.
shots.what_happens: Title card: the camera keeps drifting/pushing across a collage so peripheral elements slide out left (Present menu, 'Data analysed' card) while yellow voting sticky notes with confetti, a raised-hand icon, a reaction toolbar with floating heart and fire emoji, and a 3D smartwatch settle around the static centered title; by the end a blue hand icon and a timer card enter from the right.
shots.build_rebuild: Fix a two-line bold title at frame centre and translate a larger background layer of absolutely positioned UI props (sticky notes, reaction bar, emoji, product render) slowly right-to-left with ease-in-out over ~3 s, adding a short confetti burst around the vote stickies and floating the emoji upward with a gentle yoyo.

shots.focal_element: Miro board 'Awesome Smartwatch – Product launch analysis' with a horizontal row of presentation frames and Ashley's labeled cursor
on_screen_text: Align on the problem statement and next steps
shots.typography: Native Miro product UI: small regular sans in the top bar and toolbars; board title in medium weight; frames use bold white sans headings in sentence case with small bullet body text; cursor tag is a small medium-weight label on a yellow pill.
shots.what_happens: Starts with the collage continuing (timer widget push-in to a large '02' with pause/stop controls), then a fast transition lands on the Miro board UI: the camera pans/zooms down from a chart area to a row of slide frames, settles to a framing of four frames as narration starts (w0 'Ashley, the product manager...'), Ashley's cursor moves up to the top-right Present button (w14-w18 'clicks on the present button'), and the last frame begins a zoom into the first slide.
shots.build_rebuild: Show a full-frame board screenshot/recording inside a scalable camera container, tween its translate/scale from an overview of the chart area to the frame row (~1.5 s ease-in-out), hold while a labeled custom cursor animates along a curved path to the Present button synced to word w17, then start a zoom-in toward the first frame.

shots.focal_element: First presentation slide 'Smartwatch Post-Launch Review' with the 3D smartwatch render and presenter avatars
shots.typography: Slide content: wordmark 'awesomewatch' with bold 'awesome' and light 'watch'; title in bold geometric sans, title case, two lines, white; names in bold small white with roles in regular weight beneath; cursor tag small medium-weight on yellow pill.
shots.what_happens: Presentation mode: the first frame fills the screen almost edge to edge with a slim vertical tool strip at left and Ashley's cursor near the watch; the frame holds nearly static while VO says she can present any content on the board (w19-w28); at the end the camera pulls back slightly revealing the white board and the edge of the next frame on the right.
shots.build_rebuild: Display the slide frame full-bleed with a minimal 3-icon toolbar overlay on the left and a labeled cursor, hold ~3.5 s with a very slow scale drift, then tween scale down to ~0.8 and translate left over ~0.5 s so the next frame peeks in from the right.

shots.focal_element: Two adjacent frames (title slide and 'Goals for today / Non-goals for today' slide) with the presentation toolbar at bottom centre
on_screen_text: Align on the problem statement and next steps
The launch was a cross-functional effort. Today we are focused on product feedback, not marketing activities
shots.typography: Slide headings bold white sans in sentence case, two lines; bullets in small regular/medium white sans; presentation toolbar in tiny regular grey UI sans.
shots.what_happens: Brief (~0.4 s) in-between move: the camera has pulled out and is sliding left from the title frame to the Goals/Non-goals frame, with the presentation toolbar ('1/10', attendee count, Stop) visible at the bottom, illustrating 'choose certain frames' (w32-w34).
shots.build_rebuild: Tween the board container's translateX by one frame width (~0.4 s, ease-in-out) at a reduced scale so two frames are visible mid-move, with a fixed bottom-centre pill toolbar showing a '1/10' page counter, next arrow, attendee count and Stop button.
